summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Iteration 8 features: Blank/Filled filter capability on ALL columns in Reports grid. All backend APIs (100% pass rate - 12/12 tests) and frontend features working correctly.
passed_tests: Admin login with correct credentials (admin@example.com / admin123)
Grid BF toggle button cycles: All (BF grey) → Blank (B red) → Filled (F green) → All
Grid Blank mode (B, red) filters to show only rows where column is empty/blank
Grid Filled mode (F, green) filters to show only rows where column has a value
Grid filter count indicator shows correct X/Y when blank or filled mode is active (e.g., Grid: 8/11)
BF toggle works on standard columns: Style No (2 blank, 9 filled), Customer, Fabric, Rate, PO No, PO Rcvd, Dept, Created, Comment
BF toggle works on dynamic stage columns: Strike Off Receipt Date (8 blank, 3 filled)
Text input is disabled when BF mode is active, placeholder shows 'Blank' or 'Filled'
Clear All resets both grid text filters AND grid modes (blank/filled)
Stage Filters bar (More Filters section): text-type stages have BF toggle button that cycles Blank → Filled → clear
Stage Filters bar: select-type stages (S-OFF STATUS, TEST SELECT STAGE) have 'Blank' and 'Filled' options in dropdown
Backend /api/reports/enquiries handles __blank__ stage filter (returns enquiries where stage has no value)
Backend /api/reports/enquiries handles __filled__ stage filter (returns enquiries where stage has a non-empty value)
Backend: Blank + Filled counts equal Total (8 + 3 = 11 for Strike Off Receipt Date)
Backend /api/reports/export-excel handles __blank__ and __filled__ stage filters
Existing text-based stage filters still work (regex search for '2026')
Existing standard filters still work correctly (customer_name, fabric_type, etc.)
Combined standard and stage filters work correctly
Multiple stage filters with blank/filled on different stages work correctly
Select-type stage __blank__ filter works
Select-type stage __filled__ filter works
Select-type stage specific option filter works
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing 11 enquiries with 3 having Strike Off Receipt Date filled and 8 blank.

Grid filter count indicator shows X/Y when filters active. Existing stages: Strike Off Receipt Date (8 blank, 3 filled), CAD Ready Date, Design No, S-Off Status (select with APPROVED/REJECTED + Blank/Filled options), Test Select Stage (select), Test Stage, Test Stage 2.
